posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina Kaif has begun shooting her superhero film in Abu Dhabi directed by Ali Abbas Zafar, with an international crew and Vicky Kaushal reportedly joining the cast.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit Dosanjh is tearing through his massive US arena tour, with recent stops at State Farm Arena in Atlanta and more North American dates lined up through summer 2026.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia Bhatt presented at BAFTA 2026 alongside Cillian Murphy, spoke about gender representation at Cannes, and is gearing up for her action debut in YRF's Alpha.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka Chopra is reportedly in talks for Bond 26 and is returning to Indian cinema with 'Varanasi' after presenting at both the Golden Globes and Oscars 2026.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK is filming 'King' in South Africa with daughter Suhana Khan, Deepika Padukone, and Abhishek Bachchan — locked for a Christmas 2026 release with a Rs 350 crore budget.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena has wrapped crime thriller 'Daayra' and signed one of India's biggest films for her 25th Bollywood year, with a superhero film alongside Salman Khan also in the works.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha Kapoor is shooting the fantasy film Naagin after wrapping her biopic Eetha, and is now in talks to star opposite Vicky Kaushal in Maddock Films' Mahavatar.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika Padukone slammed overwork culture in Bollywood after exiting Kalki 2 and Spirit, prioritizing motherhood after welcoming daughter Dua with Ranveer Singh.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer Singh faces a FWICE ban over his abrupt exit from Don 3, with Rs 45 crore in damages demanded. He made his first public appearance at Mumbai Airport wearing a mask.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan stunned at the Cannes 2026 closing ceremony in a sculptural white Cheney Chan couture pantsuit — her 24th appearance at the festival, with daughter Aaradhya by her side.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika Mandanna presented at the Crunchyroll Anime Awards 2026 in Tokyo alongside Winston Duke, and her rom-com Cocktail 2 with Shahid Kapoor releases June 19.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha's comeback film 'Maa Inti Bangaaram' trailer dropped showing her fierce action avatar as a daughter-in-law. The film releases June 19 after postponing to avoid the IPL clash.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun officially announced his sci-fi collaboration AA22xA6 with director Atlee on his 43rd birthday, featuring VFX-heavy action set for a massive 2026-2027 global release.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's highly anticipated sports drama 'Peddi' releases June 4 with a 3-hour runtime. A new peppy promo track with Shruti Haasan and Janhvi Kapoor just dropped.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's NTRNeel with Prashanth Neel is set for June 25, 2026, while Devara 2 is officially confirmed and his epic dance showdown with Hrithik in War 2 wraps soon.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi Kapoor's 'Homebound' was selected as India's official entry for the 2026 Oscars, and she stars opposite Ram Charan in Peddi releasing June 4.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya Panday's 'Chand Mera Dil' crossed Rs 18 crore worldwide in its opening weekend, though her fusion Bharatanatyam dance sequence sparked viral debate online.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: New mom Kiara Advani shared how she whispered reassurances to baby Saraayah during emotional shoots while filming 'Toxic' with Yash, set for a June 2026 release.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik Roshan will direct Krrish 4 for a 2027 release, while War 2 — India's most expensive spy thriller at Rs 400 crore — wraps with a final dance showdown with Jr NTR.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun Dhawan's rom-com 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' with Mrunal Thakur and Pooja Hegde is set for a June 2026 release, marking his father David Dhawan's final directorial.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya Ghoshal wrapped her All Hearts Tour in Mumbai and has announced major 2026 concert dates across the US and UK, including Texas Trust CU Theatre in September.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman took a 40-day digital detox to compose the Ramayana soundtrack, praising Hans Zimmer's collaboration and calling it 'one of India's greatest movies.' He also launched Rooh Records.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Thalapathy Vijay turned 51 on May 25, with fans celebrating his legacy. His political action thriller 'Jana Nayagan' faces release delays amid censorship and political controversy.
